name: FFS_ACTIVITY_LINK
description: Stores links created between actual activities.

columns.name: FROM_ID
columns.description: Identifier of the first linked activity. Reference to ffs_activity.aid.

columns.name: TO_ID
columns.description: Identifier of the second linked activity. Reference to ffs_activity.aid.

columns.name: MIN_INTERVAL
columns.description: Defines if the minimum time delay is used for this activity link.

columns.name: MIN_INTERVAL_VALUE
columns.description: Minimum time interval (in minutes) between subsequent linked activities, for the links that define the relative order of the activities. This parameter can only be sent if it is configured as 'Adjustable' in the link template configuration. If the parameter is missing in the request, the value from the template wil be used.

columns.name: MAX_INTERVAL
columns.description: Defines if the maximum time delay is used for this activity link.

columns.name: MAX_INTERVAL_VALUE
columns.description: Maximum time interval (in minutes) between subsequent linked activities, for the links that define the relative order of the activities. This parameter can only be sent if it is configured as 'Adjustable' in the link template configuration. If the parameter is missing in the request, the value from the template wil be used.

columns.name: SCHEDULING
columns.description: Activity link restriction On Date Selection ('Same day,'different days').

columns.name: ASSIGNMENT
columns.description: Actiivty link restriction On Resource Selection ('Same Resource'.'Different Resource').

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.
